customer_answers:
For an ordinary Standard Visitor application, you do not need to buy flights or book a hotel just to supply booking evidence. The official guide describes hotel bookings and flight bookings (except transit) as less useful evidence. Intended arrangements should be described accurately, without presenting unbooked plans as confirmed bookings.
GOV.UK: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/visitor-visa-guide-to-supporting-documents/guide-to-supporting-documents-visiting-the-uk#documents-you-should-not-use-as-evidence

If you need a Standard Visitor visa, apply online, book a visa application centre appointment, and follow the identity and document steps.
